verdict.rationale: Kick's own Bill Pay tab documents a live view of outstanding bills, AP aging and vendor balances, but that data comes from syncing Ramp or BILL. AR & AP is gated to the Plus plan. The docs show only a current, live view, with no as-of-date or historical AP aging report to satisfy 'at any point in time.' Missing for 10: point-in-time/as-of-date AP aging and vendor balance reporting, AP data that does not depend on Ramp/BILL sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time

citations.quote: Kick's Bill Pay tab gives you a live view of your outstanding bills, AP aging (how long unpaid bills have been outstanding), and vendor balances - synced directly from Ramp or BILL.
